# Toko Kopi Sea (Kopi SEA)

> Kedai kopi dengan 3 cabang. Andalan: Kopi Aktif Aren (es kopi gula aren). Buka setiap hari pukul 09.00-22.00 WITA. Pesan langsung lewat aplikasi toko tiap cabang.

## Cabang dan pesan langsung

- [Toko Kopi Sea Mappaoddang](https://shop.runut.tech/points?id=162-0362706-B74D-4E6C-9485-F38A9A3755D9): Jalan Andi Mappaoddang. Peta: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=-5.1761848,119.4098693
- [Toko Kopi Sea PK7](https://shop.runut.tech/points?id=164-7F83712-76B4-4C5C-A725-C681B367A865): Perintis Kemerdekaan 7 (depan Stage PK 7.02). Peta: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=-5.1361401,119.4828029
- [Toko Kopi Sea Toddopuli 10](https://shop.runut.tech/points?id=165-0C7F9E1-1D79-47CD-AF5B-296DE655D098): Toddopuli 10. Peta: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=-5.1654372,119.4589085

## Media sosial

- [Instagram @toko.kopisea](https://www.instagram.com/toko.kopisea/): kabar menu dan promo

## Menu dan harga (rupiah)

- Ice Coffee: Kopi Aktif Aren Rp15.000; Kopi Aktif Aren Premium Rp25.000; Kopi Sosial (Susu) Ice Rp15.000; Kopi Pandan Ice Rp17.000; Americano Ice Rp15.000; Americano Spesial Beans Rp18.000; Butterscotch Rp20.000; Kopi Sunrise Rp17.000; Avocado Coffee Ice Rp15.000; Peach Mont Blanc Ice Rp17.000
- Hot Coffee: Kopi Aktif Aren Hot Rp13.000; Kopi Sosial (Susu) Hot Rp13.000; Hot Americano Rp13.000
- Non Coffee: Matcha Cloud Rp15.000; Chocolate Cloud Rp15.000; Lemon Honey Rp15.000; Air Botol Alkaline 600ml Rp6.000
- Camilan: Keripik Pisang Rp12.000; Keripik Pisang Dampo Rp17.000; Keripik Seblak Rp12.000
- Literan: Kopi Aktif 1 Liter Rp80.000
- Add On: Extra Creamy Rp3.000; Extra Shot Rp3.000
